method: Named and unknown labels are kept separately. For each rank include all four eager target bodies (first Attention HcPre through final HcPost) and all 227 target graph replays. Sum durations even across concurrent streams, layers and ranks, deliberately overcrediting elimination of affected work. No clock alignment is needed for batch bounds.

The device HcPre of a nonempty eager step must follow the same rank’s worker-entry timestamp. Under stable clock rates the minimum device_start - host_entry gives an upper offset for a common client/worker monotonic clock. Count every graph whose start could precede each original first token, including its whole duration, and every eager task that could have started by then. Add a separate 100 ms offset stress. Recompute all eight client times, including potential benefit from earlier work on other requests.

The joint set is one deterministic feasible grouping, not the maximum-cardinality set. Existing op semantics, output and external schedule/overheads held fixed. A rewrite that changes producer work elsewhere, memory or communication interference, host submissions, unlabelled graph nodes, draft kernels, work outside the recorded eager brackets or iteration count requires a new combined budget. A missing label establishes no semantic independence.
